notes.title: Galvanic Bride is released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387613/d37f8fc5adaba072102c96e8add3cfbf2b5d8592.png[/img]

Hello Gamers! This is IA GAMES.
We are delighted to announce the release of Galvanic Bride on Steam!

Galvanic Bride is a stealth game, with unique concepts and skills, choices and stories, with eerie atmosphere starring a cute little character. 


We’re relieved to finally release our game, but this also marks a new beginning. We’re a student team with limited resources, but will try our best and make the best game. 

We’ve found problems with the current build, and updated some crucial problems influencing gameplay. We are working on other issues as well, and will return with a new update as soon as possible. 
 
If additional problems occur, a mail report to 
[b]itisalivegames@gmail.com[/b]
about the bug will be big help in resolving the issue.

Thank you!
